test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Reluctent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **'Reluctant.'** • The incorrect spelling in option 1 has an extra** 'e' **after** 't.'** • **"Reluctant" **means** **not wanting to do something because you are not sure it is the right thing to do. ((कोई विशेष कार्य करने का) अनिच्‍छुक (उसके औचित्‍य में कुछ संदेह के कारण)) • **Example**: *I was having such a good time I was **reluctant**__ to leave.* • The correct pronunciation is **ri-luhk-tuhnt.** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2: Cautious** means being careful and avoiding risks. (सावधान, सतर्क, चौकस) • **Option 3: Ordinary** means having no special or distinctive features. (साधारण; अन्‍यों से असामान्‍य या अलग नहीं, अन्‍यों के समान) • **Option 4: Slippery** means difficult to hold or move because of being smooth, wet, or slimy. ((कोई सतह या वस्‍तु) फिसलन भरा (चिकना, गीला आदि होने के कारण जहाँ चलना या जिसे पकड़ना कठिन हो)) 39:T5f7, The correct answer is **"Tell something that should be kept secret."**
